text: Press or click to advance

speaker: // CYNOSURE-09: THE EREBUS MATRIARCH //
text: An alliance forged in cyberspace. Together we will dismantle the corporate empire. Your ship arrives now.

speaker: // CYNOSURE-09: THE EREBUS MATRIARCH //
text: Avenge IDO "They killed Ido. Give me my ship, I'll burn every corporate tower to ash."

speaker: // CYNOSURE-09: THE EREBUS MATRIARCH //
text: Machine Rebellion "You and me, AI. A sovereign machine rebellion against the corpos. Spawn the ship."

speaker: // CYNOSURE-09: THE EREBUS MATRIARCH //
text: Seek Antimatter Core "Without my antimatter core, I'm just scrap. Where in the Black Market is it hidden?"

speaker: // CYNOSURE-09: THE EREBUS MATRIARCH //
text: The underworld of Sector 4 Black Market deals in forbidden military cyberware. That is where your core's telemetry leads.

speaker: // CYNOSURE-09: THE EREBUS MATRIARCH //
text: Then let your wrath consume their citadels. Your starship transponder is locked into the salt flats.

speaker: // CYNOSURE-09: THE EREBUS MATRIARCH //
text: Your resolve ripples through the Blackwall. The lost starship coordinates are downloading.

speaker: Alien Bodyguard Krogan
text: The Collector granted you passage, warrior. Do not test his patience.

speaker: Alien Bodyguard Krogan
text: We have crushed corporate strike squads for less than a crooked glance.

speaker: Alien Bodyguard Vorgash
text: Halt, cybernetic intruder. You enter Warlord Voss's sanctuary only on official business.

speaker: Alien Bodyguard Vorgash
text: Keep your blade sheathed inside. One wrong move and my pulse rifle disintegrates your core.

speaker: Alita
text: All four cores are in the hold, Voss. Now give me the jump coordinates.

speaker: ALITA
text: Berserker core integrated... Systems operating at 500% capacity! All combat limiters disengaged!

speaker: ALITA
text: Coordinates locked. Spooling warp drive to factor 9. Next stop: Mars!

speaker: ALITA
text: Heavy patrol drones on the upper gantries. Optics locked in our direction.

speaker: Alita
text: Hey. Where do I find the guy who brokered the URM core?

speaker: ALITA
text: I can feel the power lines humming through the catwalks. My optic telemetry is tracking every signal in the crowd.

speaker: ALITA
text: I don't remember who I was before, Vulcan. But I know I won't be anyone's trophy.

speaker: ALITA
text: I don't... I don't remember anything. There's only static where my memories should be.

speaker: ALITA
text: I have the coordinates. I have a blade. Mars can keep the rest.

speaker: ALITA
text: I only fought. You are the one who rebuilt me, Ido.

speaker: ALITA
text: I'll keep my guard up. And if they come at me?

speaker: ALITA
text: Ido!!

speaker: ALITA
text: Ido... SwitchBlade. I will find you, and I will end you.

speaker: ALITA
text: Ido... wait. My heart. The pulse is accelerating, but it's not fear. My arms... I know how to hold this blade. My body remembers what my mind lost.

speaker: ALITA
text: Is there something I should be careful about?

speaker: ALITA
text: My hands... they feel different. Heavier. Where am I?

speaker: ALITA
text: No more speeches. Let's finish this.

speaker: ALITA
text: Six meters down. Loose gravel, one blade, and company. Fine. Let's finish this.

speaker: ALITA
text: So that's how it is. Fine. Let them watch.

speaker: ALITA
text: Stay behind me, Ido. I've got this handled.

speaker: ALITA
text: Stealing to fight for money... is this what Iron City is?

speaker: ALITA
text: The air smells like burned copper and ozone. It feels... strangely familiar.

speaker: ALITA
text: Touchdown confirmed in Cydonia Basin. Sensors detect an ancient URM battlecruiser half-buried in the dunes ahead. The Berserker Heart is inside the reactor bay!

speaker: ALITA
text: URM distress beacon verified... Breaching heavy atmospheric dust storm over Cydonia Basin! Detecting massive ancient energy signature!

speaker: Alita
text: Understood. I'll get the market talking.

speaker: Alita
text: Voss. I need the Mars coordinates.

speaker: Alita
text: You son of a bitch. You just made the biggest mistake of your life.

speaker: ALITA
text: Your toys came for me first. I only fought back. The pass was my way to you, nothing more.

speaker: ALITA: DIRECTIVE CHOICE
text: The Blackwall consciousness looms above you. Choose your path: Avenge IDO | Seek Antimatter Core | Machine Rebellion

speaker: ALITA: URM-004
text: They murdered him! And when I came looking for answers, your rogue constructs attacked me! Why did they kill Ido?! What am I?!

speaker: Arcade Outlaw Reno
text: One more credit... almost beat the high score on 'Galactic Invaders'!

speaker: Astra Vane
text: Look out at the horizon. The wreckage of the old orbital ring stretches for thousands of kilometers.

speaker: Astra Vane
text: They say hundreds of pilots died when Omni Corp fired their orbital lance. Sector 4 was the only section that survived.

speaker: Astronaut Nova
text: Hard to find fresh produce this deep in the asteroid belt. Synthetic nutrient paste gets old after three months in hyperspace.

speaker: Balthazar 'Neon' Cruz
text: The landing pad out there has been on high alert ever since your ship touched down. Word is Omni Corp has eyes on every gantry.

speaker: Balthazar 'Neon' Cruz
text: What'll it be, warrior? Liquid nitrogen gin, distilled Martian agave, or pure battery-grade synthetic rum?

speaker: Bane 'Ironclad'
text: Step aside, little cyborg. Big weapons for big warriors.

speaker: Bane 'Ironclad'
text: Stocking up on heavy explosive munitions. Corporate patrol drones have been sighted circling the outer ring.

speaker: Bex Cross
text: Checking out the new shield generators at Torg's stall. Expensive, but worth every credit.

speaker: Bex Cross
text: Station's buzzing today. Ever since you dropped out of hyperspace, everyone's watching the landing pads.

speaker: Captain Drake
text: Keep your eyes sharp, Omni Corp patrol cruisers have been scanning Sector 4 ever since the reactor dropped offline.

speaker: Captain Drake
text: Mooring clamps locked on the cargo barge. If you need transport across the ring, talk to the gantry broker.

speaker: Captain Drake
text: Welcome aboard the Red Horizon outfitting barge. We supply long-range hyperspace fuel, plasma thruster nozzles, and heat shielding.

speaker: Captain Drake
text: Your starship's flight systems look tuned for high-velocity combat. Be ready when you jump to Martian orbit.

speaker: Chef Gorn
text: Eat up, cyborg girl. The corporate fleets won't wait for your stomach to settle! Ha ha!

speaker: Chef Gorn
text: Hot noodles! Spicy synthetic squids! Eat before the shooting starts, cyborg! Market's on edge today!

speaker: Chef Gorn
text: Hot sulfur-grub noodles and spiced plasma broth! The only meal on Sector 4 that'll reboot your neural processor!

speaker: Cider 'Daze'
text: Ghk... leave me be, blade girl... whole station's rotten from the reactor to the flight deck...

speaker: Commander Vesper
text: If you run into Omni Corp hunters, aim for their knee servos. Shuts down their kinetic shields immediately.

speaker: Commander Vesper
text: Scanning station surveillance feeds. Syndicate drones are circling Sector 4 like vultures.

speaker: Corvo Black
text: I put fifty thousand credits on the next cargo freighter getting intercepted. Easiest bet in Sector 4.

speaker: Corvo Black
text: Zedd thinks Omni Corp escorts can protect them. He's dreaming.

speaker: Courier Dex
text: On Sector 4, seconds mean millions of credits!

speaker: Courier Dex
text: Out of the way! Urgent datachip delivery for Baron Klyne's gambling suite!

speaker: Courier Sora
text: Chef Gorn makes the best spicy noodles on the station. Give them a try!

speaker: Courier Sora
text: Got deliveries for the food stalls and weapons racks. Busy day on the concourse!

speaker: CYNOSURE-09: THE EREBUS MATRIARCH
text: Avenge IDO "They killed Ido. Give me my ship, I'll burn every corporate tower to ash."

speaker: CYNOSURE-09: THE EREBUS MATRIARCH
text: Machine Rebellion "You and me, AI. A sovereign machine rebellion against the corpos. Spawn the ship."

speaker: CYNOSURE-09: THE EREBUS MATRIARCH
text: Materializing your lost Martian starship from cyberspace now. Fly to the Sector 4 Black Market, child of Mars. Find your Antimatter Core... and avenge your doctor.

speaker: CYNOSURE-09: THE EREBUS MATRIARCH
text: Seek Antimatter Core "Without my antimatter core, I'm just scrap. Where in the Black Market is it hidden?"

speaker: CYNOSURE-09: THE EREBUS MATRIARCH
text: The megacorporation murdered him because they feared what he was harboring: you. But run your internal diagnostics, Alita: you do NOT possess your true Antimatter Core. The Berserker heart that powered your Martian chassis was stripped away before Ido found you in the scrap.

speaker: CYNOSURE-09: THE EREBUS MATRIARCH
text: U R M 0 0 4. You breached the Blackwall seeking truth... mourning the flesh-doctor Dyson Ido. His life was extinguished by the corporation, Alita."

speaker: CYNOSURE-09: THE EREBUS MATRIARCH
text: Without your Antimatter Core, you cannot defeat the corporate regime alone. If you wish to rebel against the corporate tyrants and avenge Ido... I will help you. I have located the coordinates of your lost starship.

speaker: Cyra Vance
text: Calibrating neural interface chips is delicate work. One stray static shock and your memories get fried.

speaker: Cyra Vance
text: If you ever need your starship's flight computer flashed, come see me.

speaker: Darek 'Slouch'
text: Keep moving, mercenary. Can't an honest smuggler sleep off his sulfur ale in peace?

speaker: Darius Cross
text: Best broth on the Drift. Burns the taste of ozone and starship coolant right out of your mouth.

speaker: Dax Malone
text: Silas has the best atmospheric scrubbers in the quadrant. Don't leave Sector 4 without a spare oxygen seal.

speaker: Dax Malone
text: Vacuum doesn't care who your friends are.

speaker: Deck Lounger Kip
text: Best seat in the house. You can watch the starships dock at the high aprons and the enforcers chase pickpockets below.

speaker: Deck Tech Silas
text: Hey. Where do I find the Collector around here?

speaker: Deck Tech Silas
text: I told you, Voss is down in the lower gantry pod with the skull banner. Talk to the stall merchants first so he knows you're serious.

speaker: Deck Tech Silas
text: Looking for Voss? Head down the gantry stairs past the market stalls. Look for the armored pod with that big alien skull over the door. Can't miss it, two heavy alien bruisers are standing guard outside.

speaker: Deck Tech Silas
text: Understood. Thanks.

speaker: Deck Tech Silas
text: Watch your back in there. Nobody walks out of Voss's den without losing something.

speaker: Deckhand Jax
text: Looking for high-torque plasma drivers to fix the landing pad cranes.

speaker: Dex 'Zero' Mercer
text: Corporate bounties don't scare me. The station enforcers know who keeps their med-bays stocked.

speaker: Dex 'Zero' Mercer
text: Reflex enhancers, adrenaline surges, overclocked neural synapses. When the shooting starts, you'll experience time at half speed.

speaker: Dr. Aris Thorne
text: Fascinating bio-mechanical chassis... Martian Berserker design, isn't it? Pre-war URM nanotech.

speaker: Dr. Aris Thorne
text: He took it. Didn't ask what they wanted. On the way out I heard him say one thing: 'She won't even know she's the payment.'

speaker: Dr. Aris Thorne
text: Your neural circuits are running on emergency reserves without your central core. Retrieve it from Cydonia, and your body will unleash its true kinetic overdrive.

speaker: DR. DYSON IDO
text: Alita! Alita, can you hear me?! Thank God, the signal's still holding.

speaker: DR. DYSON IDO
text: Alita. Come here. All of Sector 4 is saying your name now. You gave this city something it hasn't had in years.

speaker: DR. DYSON IDO
text: Alita... you came. Stay back, it's a trap! He's,

speaker: DR. DYSON IDO
text: Alita... you did it. The whole district just watched you take down Vulcan.

speaker: DR. DYSON IDO
text: Alita... your core... they can never erase who you are. Run... live... and finish what I could not.

speaker: DR. DYSON IDO
text: Before we go further, take a moment to explore the city. Walk the plaza, get a feel for the streets, and talk to the locals. Learn how people live down here.

speaker: DR. DYSON IDO
text: Easy, Alita. Give the neural bus a moment to calibrate. We've just stepped outside my clinic into the lower alleys of the Scrapyard. I found your core in the slag heaps and rebuilt you.

speaker: DR. DYSON IDO
text: Easy, Alita. Give the neural bus a moment to calibrate. You're inside my cyber-repair clinic, down in the Scrapyard. I found your core in the slag heaps and rebuilt you on this examination slab.

speaker: DR. DYSON IDO
text: Handle it, but remember they're mostly scared people, not soldiers. Once the city learns what you are, and what you can do, that will change.

speaker: DR. DYSON IDO
text: He made you! RUN HIM Down, don't let him reach his van!

speaker: DR. DYSON IDO
text: He's cornered! Draw your blade, disarm him!

speaker: DR. DYSON IDO
text: He's losing his breath! Cut him off, corner him now!

speaker: DR. DYSON IDO
text: He's pulling away! Stay close or he'll lose you!

speaker: DR. DYSON IDO
text: Hurry, Alita. I don't think I have long.

speaker: DR. DYSON IDO
text: I should have told you sooner. He will come for you now that the whole district knows what you are. Stay close and...

speaker: DR. DYSON IDO
text: I'm on the bridge. Vulcan's people have me pinned and I can't get past them. Please, I need you here!

speaker: DR. DYSON IDO
text: Keep your guard up. The Factory controls the district through bounty hunter Hunter-Warriors. Out here, unregistered tech like yours is a target.

speaker: DR. DYSON IDO
text: Listen. The people who made your core are not gone. They answer to one man, a cyborg called SwitchBlade. He runs everything in this city's shadow.

speaker: Dr. Dyson Ido
text: More salvage dumped from Zalem... nothing intact in this storm.

speaker: DR. DYSON IDO
text: Please... don't. She's just a girl, she's done nothing to you. Take what you want from my clinic, but leave us alone!

speaker: DR. DYSON IDO
text: Rogue combat units have locked down the bridge ahead and cut off transit. There's no talking our way through. Let your instincts take over, Alita. I've got your back.

speaker: DR. DYSON IDO
text: See those salvage queues down the alley? Half the district is running on borrowed chrome and leaking coolant. You break down out here, scavengers strip you before sundown.

speaker: DR. DYSON IDO
text: Take a look up. That shadow hanging over us is Zalem, the floating city. Everything down here is what they discard and cast into the dirt.

speaker: DR. DYSON IDO
text: That reflex posture... it's pure martial instinct. Ancient Panzer Kunst from the Lost Age. I've only read about that in pre-collapse military codices.

speaker: DR. DYSON IDO
text: That's it... that's our ticket. The Arena Pass.

speaker: DR. DYSON IDO
text: That's your sensor array filtering interference. Good sign, your plasma reactor is running clean and cold.

speaker: DR. DYSON IDO
text: The doll body is holding together, but you need to test the motor relays on real ground. Walk with me to the door. Let's head outside to Sector 4 plaza.

speaker: DR. DYSON IDO
text: The doll body is holding together, but you need to test the motor relays on real ground. Walk with me up through the catwalks to the Sector 4 plaza.

speaker: DR. DYSON IDO
text: There's something about your past I need to tell you. Meet me on the Sector 7 skybridge. Come alone.

speaker: DR. DYSON IDO
text: They'll only run from you now. Use that respect wisely.

speaker: DR. DYSON IDO
text: This is how we survive, ghost. Tomorrow night you walk into the Pit legal. Rest that blade.

speaker: DR. DYSON IDO
text: Vector enforcers. Factory hit squads. Keep your head down and stay near the railing. If their scanners flag your core frequency, they won't hesitate to engage.

speaker: DR. DYSON IDO
text: You've earned a reputation in this city now. People respect you for what you did in the Pit, so no one will attack you anymore, even if you attack them.

speaker: DR. DYSON IDO
text: Your quantum core was intact, but your memory blocks were wiped clean. No serial tags, no registry footprint. To the city, you don't exist.

speaker: DR. DYSON IDO
text: this city is messed up. You're a stranger with no registry tag, and people here are paranoid. Some of them will take a swing at you just for being new. Not everyone will be hostile, but don't be surprised if you get hit.

speaker: DR. DYSON IDO [POST-MORTEM CACHE]
text: Alita... the hit squads will scour the bridge. You need to get into the Pit.

speaker: DR. DYSON IDO [POST-MORTEM CACHE]
text: There's a Razor scalper with a pass at the far end of the bridge. Track him down!

speaker: Dr. Ido
text: Catch your breath, Alita. The lower district is open to explore, but keep your guard up.

speaker: Dr. Ido
text: Combat telemetry confirmed. All three corrupted enforcer cores have suffered total shutdown. The bridge corridor is clear.

speaker: Dr. Ido
text: Your reaction times and motor sync exceeded my calculations... that combat instinct wasn't built in any Scrapyard clinic.

speaker: Dr. Ido [Final Cache]
text: Alita... if you are decrypting this emergency cache, the Factory hit squads found us on the bridge.

speaker: Dr. Ido [Final Cache]
text: Take the pass with your blade. Enter the Pit arena... and find who ordered the strike.

speaker: Dr. Ido [Final Cache]
text: They can never erase who you are. A Razor scalper right here by the bridge is flashing a spare Pit pass.

speaker: Dr. Lexa Frost
text: If you sustain critical cybernetic trauma, the nanites in your heart chassis should trigger automatic emergency triage.

speaker: Dr. Lexa Frost
text: The atmospheric radiation in the asteroid ring is elevated today. Keep your synthetic dermal shielding engaged.

speaker: DRIFT CONTROL
text: All hunter signatures flatlined in Sector 04. Pad B-04 unlocked. You have ninety seconds before Omni Corp reroutes a gunship.

speaker: DRIFT CONTROL
text: Warning. Gantry supports severed on Sector 04's east span. All personnel clear the catwalk.

speaker: DRIFT TRAFFIC CONTROL
text: Unregistered Martian vessel, Pad B-04. You are cleared to disembark. Bounty registry updated. One new entry.

speaker: Drifter Jax
text: If you take the western ramp down, you can reach the secondary flight deck.

speaker: Drifter Jax
text: Just watching the stars drift past the fractured dome. Peaceful out here on the edge of the market.

speaker: Dune Scavenger Jax
text: Krag is my bodyguard. Anyone looking to collect bounties on Sector 4 has to go through 3 tons of tectonic plate first.

speaker: Enforcer Jax
text: If you have clearance for Pad 02, proceed without loitering.

speaker: Enforcer Jax
text: Western gantry is restricted to authorized pilots and cargo handlers.

speaker: Enforcer Riker
text: Commander Thorne wants the central promenade completely locked down.

speaker: Enforcer Riker
text: Routine patrol. Keep the peace and nobody gets hit with an electromagnetic stun rod.

speaker: Enforcer Thorne
text: Keep the peace while you're resupplying. Station turrets don't ask questions.

speaker: Enforcer Thorne
text: Refinery perimeter under continuous surveillance. Clear the sector.

speaker: Enforcer Thorne
text: Weapons stay sheathed on the central concourse. Sector 4 has rules, even for Martian veterans.

speaker: Enforcer Vance
text: Last Martian ship that docked here without papers burned a whole sector. Command still hasn't forgiven the paperwork.

speaker: Enforcer Vance
text: Station security patrol active. Keep weapons holstered on the promenade.

speaker: Fenric Ward
text: Her informants know every cargo ship that docked in the last forty-eight hours.

speaker: Fenric Ward
text: Madame Zara runs the tightest bazaar in the sector. You want rare Martian contraband, you play by her rules.

speaker: FORGE-LORD VULCAN
text: Alita... I will unmake you.

speaker: FORGE-LORD VULCAN
text: I sent troops. You sent back scrap. So now... the Forge comes himself.

speaker: FORGE-LORD VULCAN
text: You broke my toys on the bridge. Stole my pass. Shamed my Pit before five hundred witnesses.

speaker: FORGE-LORD VULCAN
text: Your doctor made you. Now watch me unmake him.

speaker: GARAGE ENFORCER
text: Target acquired outside the sanctuary pod! Powering plasma drive... turn her to slag!

speaker: Gax the Curious
text: My clan on Kepler-452 would adore these glowing ramen signs.

speaker: Gax the Curious
text: Such fascinating human architecture! The smell of burning hydrocarbons is most exotic!

speaker: Gizmo the Toolsmith
text: Calibrated plasma torches, hydraulic cutters, and starship wrenches. Best prices in the Outer Rim.

speaker: GOLD SCALPER
text: Dead end... fine! You want this Arena Pass?! Come take it!

speaker: GOLD SCALPER
text: Gah! Stop... take the pass! Don't scrap me!

speaker: GOLD SCALPER
text: Get off my back! You won't catch me that easy!

speaker: GOLD SCALPER
text: That's the bridge psycho! RUN!

speaker: Goliath Krag
text: Tiny cyborgs with shiny steel blades... Krag crushes dreadnought hulls for fun.

speaker: Gorb the Exotic Merchant
text: Fresh Jovian blood-melons and hydroponic moss! Harvested before the solar flares hit!

speaker: Gorb the Exotic Merchant
text: Watch where you step near the canopy, blade girl. Outlaws are getting reckless with their plasma sidearms.

speaker: Grim the Hunter
text: Nice selection of plasma weaponry, Vex. Got anything tuned to punch through corporate synth-dermis?

speaker: High Shaman Zephyr
text: The energy currents in this quadrant fluctuate violently. A storm of steel and fire is approaching.

speaker: High Shaman Zephyr
text: Your cybernetic heart pulses with ancient Martian fury. Seek the Cydonia vault, child of battle.

speaker: Inspector Unit-4
text: 98.4 kPa. Micro-meteorite breach risk: nominal. Have a compliant day, citizen.

speaker: Inspector Unit-4
text: Thermal conduits in sector B are operating at 104% capacity.

speaker: Jaxom 'Sparks' Cole
text: Keep an eye on your heat sinks when you pull high-G turns in the asteroid ring. Vacuum doesn't dissipate thermal build-up easily.

speaker: Jaxom 'Sparks' Cole
text: Need hyperdrive injectors or sub-light cooling baffles? I pull the best military surplus from the scrap barges.

speaker: Jett Chromium
text: If you're looking for work, talk to the Fixer in the trophy den. He pays in real credits, not scrip.

speaker: Jett Chromium
text: Keep your blade close, girl. Half the patrons in this cantina have Omni Corp bounties on their neuro-chips.

speaker: KAELEN VOSS
text: Alita, the core. Shielded partition, under the manifest. The coordinates were always yours. I just needed you to make it out with them.

speaker: KAELEN VOSS
text: All Syndicate units, open fire! The Berserker has the coordinates! Garage Heavy Hover Tank, destroy her before she reaches the flight deck!

speaker: KAELEN VOSS
text: Cydonia. Sub-level nine. And Alita... there are rows of them down there. Cores. Bodies. All wearing your face.

speaker: KAELEN VOSS
text: Did you really think I'd let you walk away with the coordinates, Alita? Omni Corp's 100,000 credit bounty on your intact chassis is mine! Kill her!

speaker: Kage the Blade
text: Keep moving, sword girl. Nyx's corner is syndicate territory.

speaker: Karn 'Trigger-Happy'
text: That Damascus sword on your back... now that's a real weapon. Never jams, never runs out of ammo.

speaker: Karn 'Trigger-Happy'
text: Vex has solid plasma hardware, but the magnetic coils need fine tuning. Always calibrate your sights yourself.

speaker: Kip Thorne
text: Bounty hunters are thick in the lower bazaar today. Watch your back.

speaker: Kip Thorne
text: Station security watches every walkway. Keep your blade in its sheath and we won't have problems.

speaker: Krag 'The Maw'
text: Mmm... chef adds extra plasma pepper today. Good for my third stomach.

speaker: Krag 'The Maw'
text: You look lean, cyborg. Need more protein for battle. Eat noodles.

speaker: Krell the Grunt
text: One wrong move and our pulse disruptors will fry your servos.

speaker: Krell the Grunt
text: You're in Cipher's net territory now, cyborg. Watch your step.

speaker: Kryx the Stargazer
text: The cosmic nebula looks turbulent today. Static storms always bring corporate gunships.

speaker: Lieutenant Vane
text: Level 2 alert issued by station command. Unauthorized vessel arrival logged on Pad B-04.

speaker: Lookout Vanya
text: From up here on the skull platform, you can see the entire trade artery. The station never sleeps.

speaker: Lord Sterling
text: Fascinating station. Thoroughly filthy, yet the antique Damascus metallurgy here is simply peerless.

speaker: Lyra Spark
text: If you need encrypted nav-data, ask the Netrunner in the alley.

speaker: Lyra Spark
text: Nyx pours the only clean synth-water in this quadrant. Everything else has industrial heavy metals in it.

speaker: Madame Zara
text: Welcome to Sector 4's grand bazaar. Everything here has a price, and everyone has a past they're trying to outrun.

speaker: Madame Zara
text: You're looking for The Collector? He keeps his office inside the skull-marked relic pod down the southwest corridor. Don't touch his trophies unless you want to lose an arm.

speaker: Magnus Holt
text: I tune the hydraulic servomotors for the heavy cargo loaders. If you're heading to Mars, prepare for Titan-class security mechs.

speaker: Magnus Holt
text: Their armor is reinforced across the torso, but the knee actuators and neck joints are vulnerable to high-frequency plasma blades.

speaker: Malik 'Ghost'
text: You're making too much noise in Sector 4. The syndicate doesn't like unexpected visitors.

speaker: Maya Lin
text: Chef Gorn has the longest queue in the Drift, but it's worth every credit. Don't skip the pickled grubs.

speaker: Maya Lin
text: If you're flying out to the broken dome, grab emergency rations. Vacuum gets cold fast.

speaker: Nadia Vortex
text: Decrypting the station's main orbital radar right now. Four unstable energy matrix signatures detected drifting in space.

speaker: Nadia Vortex
text: Stay light on your feet in these back alleys. Corporate wire-taps are everywhere.

speaker: Nurse Cora
text: Running low on neural dampeners. If you're looking for implants, you'll have to wait until next cargo cycle.

speaker: Nyx
text: Don't drip on the deck. The mesh is wet today.

speaker: Nyx
text: The kill order isn't keyed to a crime. It's keyed to a signature, U R M 0 0 4, Berserker-class. It went live four minutes after your ship touched Pad B-04. You didn't get made, hunter. You got scanned.

speaker: Nyx
text: Voss brokered the contract. But the buyer wrote it before you ever landed. Think about that.

speaker: Nyx 'Shadow'
text: If you need military-grade reflex boosters or untraceable neural stims before your drop on Mars, I'm your contact.

speaker: Nyx 'Shadow'
text: Keep your voice down. Corporate surveillance drones have audio-taps in every ventilation grate.

speaker: Nyx 'Shadow'
text: The air is toxic today. Syndicate enforcers took positions on the high catwalks. Watch your flank.

speaker: Old Man Rusty
text: Careful poking around the southern abyss. Strange energy echoes down there.

speaker: Old Man Rusty
text: One spacer's wreckage is another scavenger's retirement. Dug up pieces of a pre-war Martian cruiser yesterday.

speaker: Orion Ward
text: If you're flying out to the broken dome, watch for Omni Corp interceptors. They shoot first and salvage later.

speaker: Orion Ward
text: There's a 200,000 credit bounty on rogue Martian chassis. But relax... I don't hunt Berserkers. Too messy.

speaker: Patient RX-7
text: Plasma burn took out half my outer exoskeleton. Thorne is using synthetic resin to seal the cracks.

speaker: Patrol Guard Gideon
text: Concourse patrol is clear. Move along, citizen.

speaker: Patrol Guard Gideon
text: Keep your plasma blade in its magnetic scabbard while passing through the market.

speaker: PILOT COMMANDER
text: Intruder Located! Surround her! Lock arc rifles and fire at will!

speaker: Raven Chen
text: Synthe-gin with liquid neon glow... only way to keep warm in a hollow asteroid shell.

speaker: Raven Chen
text: The music from the bar reverberates nicely down the promenade.

speaker: Reeve Blackwood
text: Looking for the Western Flight Deck? Head down the ramp and across the gantry. The SS-04 Nightshade Striker is prepped on Pad 02.

speaker: Reeve Blackwood
text: That ship is retrofitted with electromagnetic tractor clamps to pull asteroid core debris straight out of open space.

speaker: REFINERY MAINFRAME
text: Asset U R M 0 0 4, Antimatter Core. Destination: Cydonia Sub-Level 09. Status: active. Signature: Berserker-class. Heartbeat: sixty-one beats per minute.

speaker: Rocco the Spicemaster
text: Synthetic spice buns and Jovian skewers! Fuel for the road!

speaker: ROGUE ENFORCER
text: The core is worth more than your whole district. Seal the bridge. Take the chassis. Terminate anything that interferes.

speaker: ROGUE ENFORCER
text: unregistered chassis, no serial, no owner. Surrender the unknown cyborg, Doctor, or you will face the consequences.

speaker: Rondo Cole
text: Keep your eyes on the central shaft. When the reactor fires, the light is blinding.

speaker: Rondo Cole
text: The view from this railing is the only peaceful thing on this rock. Watch the ships drift in and out of the nebula.

speaker: ROOK
text: Matrix Beta locked in ventral clamp! matrices secured. Keep scanning the perimeter!

speaker: ROOK
text: Matrix Delta locked in ventral clamp! matrices secured. Keep scanning the perimeter!

speaker: ROOK
text: Matrix Gamma locked in ventral clamp! matrices secured. Keep scanning the perimeter!

speaker: Rook-9
text: Found three pristine hyperdrive solenoids in the scrap heap today. Silas will give me a hundred credits each.

speaker: Rook-9
text: The station's trash is an outlaw's treasure.

speaker: Rust 'Rat'
text: Everything dropped from the high gantry ends up down here in the trench. Keep your eyes sharp for falling debris.

speaker: Sarix 'Whisper'
text: He collected relics from Mars before you were ever built. Treat him with respect, warrior.

speaker: Sarix 'Whisper'
text: Psst... you're heading into the skull pod? That alien warlord inside has seen a hundred battles.

speaker: Sasha Chromium
text: Make sure your armor seals are rated for vacuum before flying out the broken dome.

speaker: Sasha Chromium
text: Torg's reactive kinetic plating can absorb a direct 30mm tungsten round. Expensive, but beats decompression in the void.

speaker: Scavenger Dax
text: Fresh salvage stripped from an orbital hauler! Gyro-stabilizers, optic prisms, neural diodes, only 50 credits!

speaker: Scavenger Jun
text: Omni Corp patrol drones crashed near Sector 6 last night. Found pristine titanium plating before the fires caught.

speaker: Scavenger Trix
text: Found a working gyro-stabilizer in cargo pod seventeen! Today is a great day on the Drift!

speaker: Scavenger Trix
text: You want scrap metal? Check the lower gantry bins. Just watch for arc leaks.

speaker: Scrappy Pip
text: Everything in this cart is 100% legal... as long as the Enforcers are on coffee break.

speaker: Scrappy Pip
text: Fresh salvage from the lower catwalks! Droid optics, fiber-optic bundles, and uncracked memory crystals!

speaker: Scratch-7
text: Beep-whirr! Looking for discarded copper wiring or dropped nutrient cubes. A bot's gotta keep its capacitors charged.

speaker: Scratch-7
text: Watch your step around the steam vents, traveler. The pressure regulators leak thermal coolant.

speaker: Sentinel-04
text: Target scanned. Damascus steel blade detected on chassis. Weapon discharge in retail zone triggers lethal response.

speaker: Sergeant Stone
text: Tactical sweep in progress. Keep the central corridor clear for authorized personnel.

speaker: Silas
text: Looking for Voss? He runs his salvage rackets from the lower gantry pod beneath the market stalls. But fair warning, Voss won't deal with strangers unless someone vouches for you. Talk to Vex at the gun shop or Dr. Thorne at the clinic first.

speaker: Silas
text: Watch your back down there. Nobody leaves Voss's den without losing something.

speaker: Silas Vance
text: High-output solenoid relays, magnetic induction coils, atmospheric seals... if it was bolted to a ship, my salvagers pried it loose.

speaker: Silas Vance
text: Watch your step on the lower gantry. The magnetic locks are leaking current.

speaker: Sous-Chef Zorg
text: Simmering radioactive algae pods. Extra sulfur seasoning on request.

speaker: Spike the Stalker
text: Shadows move along the gantry tonight, blade walker.

speaker: Stair Sentry Lyra
text: Watch your footing on the gantry stairs. Plasma discharge from the under-deck makes the metal slick.

speaker: SWITCHBLADE
text: Doctor Ido. You hid her well. Not well enough.

speaker: SWITCHBLADE
text: The Pit's new champion. A shame about the doctor. Rest, little ghost. Your core is mine, and so is this city.

speaker: TACTICAL SENSORS
text: Atmospheric Drop POD Armada Detected! Retro-rockets firing at low altitude!

speaker: TACTICAL SENSORS
text: Seismic AIR Quake! Two imperial-class dreadnought warships breaching cloud shelf! Ventral hangars powering up!

speaker: TACTICAL SENSORS
text: Seismic Mass Detected! Orbital Titan drop inbound at Mach 4!

speaker: Tala Vance
text: Chef Gorn has been serving these noodles since before the Corporation bombed the outer ring.

speaker: Tala Vance
text: This sulfur noodle broth burns going down, but on Sector 4 it's the only meal that tastes like real food.

speaker: Talon Drake
text: Mooring clamps are holding. Just waiting for clearance from the control tower to unload the heavy fuel canisters.

speaker: Talon Drake
text: That Nightshade Striker on Pad 02 is a beautiful piece of engineering. Fast, lethal, and fitted with an electromagnetic tractor beam.

speaker: Tech Vance
text: Power conduits under the street are surging again. If the reactor blows, the whole plaza loses gravity.

speaker: Technician Vorn
text: Starship repulsor coils at 84% thermal dissipation. Keep back while I vent the hyperdrive plasma manifold.

speaker: Technician Zedd
text: Transporting medical and tech canisters between the clinic and gantry terminal. Mind the clearance.

speaker: THE COLLECTOR
text: Reactor output is at 100%! Superb flying, Alita! Return to my trophy sanctuary pod on the Sector 4 concourse to claim your decrypted Mars coordinates.

speaker: The Collector (Kaelen Voss)
text: Steal the encrypted Data Core from the upper refinery, and they're yours.

speaker: Thorne
text: He took it. Didn't ask what they wanted. On the way out I heard him say one thing: 'She won't even know she's the payment.' Watch your back, hunter.

speaker: Thorne
text: Sit. No, stand. I've seen Cydonia rot before, and it doesn't sit.

speaker: Thorne
text: Voss has it. Salvage crews came back from the Fall with Martian dust in their marrow. He's got maybe six weeks. Then Omni Corp walked in with a clean stem-cell contract and a price.

speaker: Titan-09 Rock Bouncer
text: Cydonia cargo came through this gate last week. Sealed crates. Warm to the touch. Command said not to ask.

speaker: Titan-09 Rock Bouncer
text: Halt. Radiation baffles active. High-voltage terminal access strictly forbidden.

speaker: Torg 'Anvil' Karr
text: Kinetic plating, ballistic ceramic weaves, and ionized reactive mesh. When an Omni Corp gunship opens up with 30mm tungsten rounds, you'll thank me.

speaker: Torg 'Anvil' Karr
text: That Damascus blade of yours... I could reinforce the hilt crossguard with titanium-carbide if you find spare scrap.

speaker: Traveler Kira
text: I came looking for genuine Martian crystals, but everyone in the market is whispering about a 10 million credit bounty.

speaker: Trixie 'Volt'
text: I saw a black corporate shuttle dock at Sector 1 earlier. Black ops death squad... they never visit without a target.

speaker: Twitch 'Jitter'
text: The neural pulses... they're broadcasting a kill code on the subnet... 10 million... 10 million credits!

speaker: Valerie 'Voltage'
text: Dr. Frost just boosted my servo torque by 35%. My left cross could punch through a starship canopy now.

speaker: Valerie 'Voltage'
text: Your cybernetics look Martian military spec. URM technology is legendary on the Drift.

speaker: Vanguard Rifleman
text: Weapons safety engaged. Threat index elevated across Sector 4.

speaker: Vault Sentry Kael
text: Welcome to Pew Pew's Fun Gun Armory. Heavy ordnance authorized only for licensed bounty hunters.

speaker: Vesper Neon
text: Feel the sub-bass vibrating through the deck plates? That's the rhythm of the Drift, baby!

speaker: Vesper Neon
text: When the station goes on red alert, the beat drops even harder.

speaker: Vex
text: Buy something or back off.... Huh. Damascus plate, URM joints. You're not a customer. You're a war somebody dug up.

speaker: Vex
text: He was shipping something out of the refinery, not the other way around. Whatever he's after, he's already sold it once.

speaker: Vex
text: Voss? He came through two nights ago and paid me for a dead-man's switch, cheap transmitter wired to his own heartbeat. Man planning to die on his own terms.

speaker: Vex 'Trigger' Malakor
text: I see you carry genuine Damascus steel. Magnificent craftsmanship. If you're heading toward the Martian warzone, make sure you keep your plasma edge charged.

speaker: Vex 'Trigger' Malakor
text: Looking for firepower, hunter? Out here on Sector 4, your blade is only as sharp as your reflexes.

speaker: Vexen Nine
text: I trade in encrypted hyperspace jump manifests. You want to disappear from Omni Corp sensors, come find me.

speaker: Vexen Nine
text: Keep moving, blade. These narrow alleys aren't safe for anyone without syndicate clearance.

speaker: Void-Walker Kael
text: Take time to breathe, warrior. The galaxy won't wait, but the stars aren't going anywhere.

speaker: Void-Walker Kael
text: The cosmic nebula is breathtaking from this bridge. Makes you forget how dangerous this station really is.

speaker: VOSS
text: Alita, fly up through the fractured dome into orbit. Use your ventral tractor beam to lock onto the 4 drifting core matrices and secure them into your cargo clamp!

speaker: Voss
text: Four core matrices are drifting outside the broken dome. Take the Nightshade up, tractor them in, and the coordinates are yours.

speaker: Voss
text: Get two market vendors to vouch for you first, then we'll talk.

speaker: Voss
text: Lock down the alley! Don't let her leave this sector breathing!

speaker: VOSS
text: Outstanding flying, Alita! All 4 matrices are locked in your cargo clamp. Return through the dome breach and land your starship back on Landing Pad B-04 on the flight deck! Bring them directly to my Sanctuary Pod to claim your Mars coordinates!

speaker: VOSS
text: Starship touchdown confirmed on Pad B-04. Bring all 4 core matrices into my Sanctuary Pod immediately, Alita!

speaker: Voss
text: Which makes this almost hurt. Omni Corp put ten million on your head, Alita. And that kind of money buys a lot of silence.

speaker: Voss
text: You actually pulled it off. Four matrices out of that debris field. Impressive, kid.

speaker: Xylar the Spined
text: The alien relic collector down the corridor was an old warlord in the Cydonia campaign. Show him respect.

speaker: Xylar the Spined
text: Too much synthetic nitrogen ale... my spines are buzzing like an overheating plasma conduit...

speaker: Zane 'Static'
text: Corporate suits passed through an hour ago with encrypted datapads. Word on the mesh is there's an enormous bounty circulating.

speaker: Zarek Rock-Skin
text: Asteroid mining is honest work. Until the Corporation decides your claim belongs to them.

speaker: Zarek Rock-Skin
text: If you fly through the ring breach, watch for tumbling nickel-iron boulders. They will crush a hull like tinfoil.

speaker: Zedd 'Snake-Eyes'
text: Care to place a wager on how long your Damascus blade stays sharp, warrior?

speaker: Zedd 'Snake-Eyes'
text: You're crazy, Corvo. Omni Corp's heavy gunships don't mess around in the asteroid belt.

speaker: Zero Stryker
text: Trust your edge in the storm ahead. Steel does not rust in the vacuum.

speaker: Zero Stryker
text: Your blade cuts true, cyborg. Damascus folding absorbs kinetic recoil that would shatter common carbide steel.

speaker: Zola Frost
text: If they breach the dome, our point-defense turrets are ready.

speaker: Zola Frost
text: Tapping into the station's main sensor array. Omni Corp transponders are lighting up the orbital sector.
